scope: The same existing stream scenarios run in separate const-wrapper and/or invocation-local in-place processes as selected. Every call checks persistent Inputs semantic fields and canonical packet bytes unchanged; in-place checks actual consumer-derived scratch flags against existing receipt counters and checks packet arrays do not alias persistent Inputs. Inputs C++ padding is never compared. Finite FIRST-only host executor stream preparation: actual LYRQ/LYMP admission and full LAD1 A; actual 16-beat control request read/codec/echo receipt, 16-beat response collection and actor validation, complete response receipt with accepted sideband derived from the actor's semantic consumption count, or a late revoked GRANT fully bound to the retained actual IMPORT receipt solely for old cleanup without starting work. CLOSED has no such fallback and requires the actor's exact validator. Independent response/request receipt backpressure and response-before-receipt; 12-step tail2/tail1 waits; early, foreign, duplicate, malformed and semantic rejection; both response-before-receipt and receipt-before-late-response GRANT under persistent revoke with zero start; actual full LBR2 codec/helper IMPORT and controlled matching GRANT. Actual C++ program, lifecycle port/FSM and transaction adapter complete four diagnostic NORM windows with controlled producer and provenance terminals. Actual program LAC1 full codec acceptance generates four echo beats with tail2/tail1 waits; abstract completion and Host/control bools cannot bypass the bridge. Actual old partial LGP1 drains under persistent cancel and the program emits a bound LOCAL_REJECT result. Actual four-beat Host result read/codec/echo precedes CLOSE; wrong/old/commit/terminal CLOSED never has accepted authority; whole receipt bytes and accepted remain stable while backpressured, including revocation. Malformed response raw bytes produce only a stable accepted=false notification and sticky isolation, with no lock release or automatic recovery. Correct CLOSED is consumed once and FIRST prevents a second request. Shell replies, session/base/fences, physical safety and remote producer results remain software controlled; host hls streams are unbounded. No physical shell protection, depth2 RTL, generated executor/HLS result, LN arithmetic/AXI, complete model/graph, physical CLOSE safety, no-LGP local error, full error matrix, hardware rearm, second-request handover, OOC, timing, resources or board claim.
